changeSet.author: MIND
changeSet.comment: Parametros del servidor de correo y del remitente usados para los avisos
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE configuracion_smtp ( config_id NUMBER GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY, smtp_host VARCHAR2(255 CHAR) NOT NULL, smtp_port NUMBER NOT NULL, use_tls CHAR(1 CHAR) DEFAULT 'N' NOT NULL, smtp_username VARCHAR2(255 CHAR), secreto_ref VARCHAR2(512 CHAR), sender_address VARCHAR2(254 CHAR) NOT NULL, sender_display_name VARCHAR2(100 CHAR) NOT NULL, facilities_fallback_email VARCHAR2(254 CHAR), max_attempts NUMBER DEFAULT 3 NOT NULL, is_active CHAR(1 CHAR) DEFAULT 'N' NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, updated_by NUMBER NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT pk_configuracion_smtp PRIMARY KEY (config_id), CONSTRAINT ck_configuracion_smtp_port CHECK (smtp_port BETWEEN 1 AND 65535), CONSTRAINT ck_configuracion_smtp_tls CHECK (use_tls IN ('Y','N')), CONSTRAINT ck_configuracion_smtp_activa CHECK (is_active IN ('Y','N')), CONSTRAINT ck_configuracion_smtp_intentos CHECK (max_attempts >= 1) )

changeSet.author: MIND
changeSet.comment: Como maximo una configuracion SMTP activa
changeSet.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_configuracion_smtp_una_activa ON configuracion_smtp (CASE WHEN is_active = 'Y' THEN 1 END)
